Arclin expands Firepoint distribution through partnership with Weyerhaeuser
November 25, 2026 | 8:17 am CST
Arclin expands Firepoint distribution through partnership with Weyerhaeuser

ALPHARETTA, Ga. — Arclin, a materials science company, has announced a new distribution partnership with Weyerhaeuser to expand availability of Arclin Firepoint throughout Southern California. Weyerhaeuser will stock Firepoint, Arclin’s proprietary, fire-resistant structural sheathing, at its Fontana and Santa Clarita, California, locations, providing lumber dealers, builders, contractors, and other building professionals with greater access to the product.

The partnership builds on Arclin’s continued expansion of Firepoint’s California distribution network, supporting the use of building materials that enhance fire resilience without adding complexity to the construction process. Designed for applications such as residential, multifamily, and Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) zones, Firepoint combines structural performance with enhanced fire resistance in a panel that installs like conventional sheathing.

“Southern California is an important market for Firepoint, particularly as builders and communities continue looking for practical ways to improve fire resilience,” said Matthew Bruce, Arclin’s vice president of sales, Downstream Products. “Our partnership with Weyerhaeuser strengthens our ability to serve building professionals across the region, making it easier for customers to incorporate enhanced fire protection into their projects.”

Firepoint incorporates proprietary intumescent technology onto the panel to enhance fire resistance while preserving the structural strength and stiffness builders expect from conventional sheathing. When used in select wall assemblies, Firepoint exceeds code by 50% or more, helping slow fire and providing critical time to protect lives and property.* The product also meets California WUI (Chapter 7A) requirements.

Firepoint is available in 8-foot and 10-foot panel lengths, with a larger 4×10-foot panel size added to the product lineup in 2026. The larger panel supports taller wall and multifamily applications while helping reduce seams, fasteners, material waste, and installation time.
*Per ASTM E-119 testing conducted in a third-party accredited laboratory.
